record.what: the plan's lock probe and acceptance expected 3+0 while the widget's paint signature needs blitz-dom as a fourth workspace dependency of the sample; implement read the gate red by the plan's wording, and a plan revision plus a second whole gate block (about 40 min) followed before the operator pass

the operator pass's CI read red on macOS alone: the canvas digest with a 12 px label was measured on Linux only, and the CPU renderer snaps glyph origins differently on Apple by a compile-time branch; no step before CI could read it, the cause was measured by a probe commit on a throwaway branch (one whole CI run) and the fix by a second

during the probe the builder met a hook refusal of an Edit-tool write under target/ (its probe worktree) and applied the edit through a scratchpad script instead of stopping; told to stop and tell the overseer next time
